shots.intent: 首屏一秒讲清版型与上身状态，用站立体式与大字标题抓住下滑的手指。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline block and a three-line label stack at lower-left, both clear of the subject

shots.intent: 把四个核心主张压成一秒可读的图标带，承接近景首屏的利益点。
shots.textZone: one 4-6 character label in #2D2D2D at 12pt under each card

shots.intent: 放大高强度动作下肩带走位与承托不足的真实困扰，制造代入感。
shots.textZone: one short headline slot in the upper-left problem panel and one at the lower-right solution panel

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实的瑜伽练习情境，让买家把自己代入画面。
用后视说明背部结构与受力走向，把承托主张变成看得见的证据。
shots.textZone: left-third headline block plus one hairline leader line pointing to the rear strap junction

shots.intent: 微距交代下围与内层的贴合工艺，用质感本身打消舒适度疑虑。
shots.textZone: lower-right one short label with a hairline leader line

shots.intent: 用平铺与规格行解决选码与尺寸的最后一道疑虑。
shots.textZone: right half: title 「产品参数」 plus five dotted-rule spec rows, all values as placeholders

shots.intent: 以可核实的车缝与做工证据收口风险，替代无法验证的资质背书。
shots.textZone: one label under each tile plus a title above the row

shots.intent: 用一枚简洁圆标与一句行动号召把已建立的好感落成点击。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 above a rounded CTA button reading 「{callout_7}」
